atlases.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: production diffuse texture atlas for Anarchy Online Omni-Tek city architecture. Input image 1 is the edit target, an exact 4 by 4 array of sixteen existing surface textures. Repaint each cell with refined high-detail physically plausible futuristic architectural materials. Majestic modern Omni city: restrained desaturated graphite green-grey panels, satin gunmetal, precise brushed metal edging, polished clean corporate construction, subtle fine wear, neat seams. Preserve each cell's original colour family, brightness relationships, panels, ornamental bands, windows, vents, grooves, lamp locations, and precise UV layout. All sixteen cells must remain distinct in the SAME row-major positions, with every major feature at exactly its original normalized location. Plain panels remain plain; do not add windows or machinery. Matching metal and plaster recipes across cells, fine material grain, crisp construction, no large stains or excessive corrosion. Glass dark and cool, metal neutral; no gold tint. Remove baked lighting gradients while keeping structural cavities and existing lamp shapes. Flat orthographic diffuse surface only, NO perspective, render, scene, exterior framing, bevelled cell borders, gutters, labels, watermark, contact-sheet margins, or extra geometry. Fill the entire square with exactly 4x4 equal square texture cells edge to edge. Request 2048x2048 output. This is Omni family atlas 0; follow the target's per-cell layout exactly.
